# Game Rant

> > Game Rant is a gaming and entertainment news site covering video game guides, anime analysis, industry news, and pop culture content across franchises like One Piece, Dragon Ball, Pokemon, Call of Duty, and The Sims.

Game Rant delivers a mix of gaming walkthroughs, weapon loadouts, industry news, and anime/manga coverage with a focus on popular franchises. The site features opinion pieces, theory articles, hands-on previews, and comprehensive guides for both casual and competitive gaming audiences.

## Key Topics

- One Piece theories and spoilers
- Dragon Ball Super transformations
- Pokemon GO raid guides
- Call of Duty weapon loadouts
- The Sims 4 updates
- Open-world games
- Anime character analysis
- Devil Fruit powers
- Saiyan forms and power levels
- Gaming industry news
- Cozy farming simulators
- PlayStation 5 hardware
- Roblox content
- Kingdom Come Deliverance
- Solo Leveling anime
